research_question: Can the independently positive V17 OI position-buildup route be activated only when its fully matured 90-day and 180-day after-cost history remain positive, then combined with the rare V28 breadth trend under one global slot?

OI_POSITION_BUILDUP.maturity_rule: an event may enter router history only when its recorded exit timestamp is strictly earlier than the new entry timestamp

BREADTH_6H_TREND.activation: always active because its fixed family was independently positive in development and stability; no outcome-based threshold is changed

causal_router.same_entry_priority: larger causal family score, then family priority, then symbol
causal_router.overlap: reject an entry before the selected active proposal's recorded exit
causal_router.duplicate_episode: same family, symbol and entry timestamp may appear once

advance_gate.final_integrated_frequency_requirement: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Freeze the causal activation and family arbitration unchanged, then implement it inside one NautilusTrader account.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune the performance windows or activation thresholds after evaluation; preserve only positive components.
